title: Modern Full Home Renovation
shortDescription: A complete luxury residential overhaul blending open-concept living, structural enhancements, and bespoke architectural woodwork tailored for contemporary living in Dhaka.
description:
This full-home renovation transformed an expansive duplex apartment into a harmonious, light-flooded modern sanctuary in the heart of Dhaka. Dwellora managed every phase of the project from structural partition adjustments and layout optimization to the installation of high-efficiency climate integration and custom architectural woodwork.

The ground floor was reconfigured into an open-concept living, dining, and family lounge centered around premium matte-finish engineered timber flooring. Custom fluted teak wall panels, acoustic ceiling reveals, and concealed pocket doors deliver effortless spatial flow while maintaining distinct functional zones. The upper private quarters feature tailored master suites with acoustic insulation, custom walk-in closets, and spa-inspired ensuite bathrooms designed with climate-resilient materials built for everyday comfort.

title: Contemporary Kitchen Makeover
shortDescription: A chef-grade modern kitchen transformation featuring floor-to-ceiling moisture-resistant cabinetry, a mitered quartz waterfall island, and built-in appliances.
description:
Designed for modern lifestyle cooking and seamless entertaining, this contemporary kitchen makeover in Banani replaces a dark, closed kitchen with an ergonomic, high-performance culinary hub. Dwellora re-engineered the spatial layout to maximize counter space, ventilation efficiency, and organized pantry storage.

The kitchen's centerpiece is an expansive central waterfall island fabricated from premium Calacatta quartz with comfortable breakfast counter seating. Surrounding custom cabinetry was milled from solid hardwood frames with moisture-proof marine-grade cores, finished in an ultra-matte polyurethane lacquer and equipped with heavy-duty Blum soft-close hardware. Discrete under-cabinet LED task lighting, a high-power exhaust ventilation canopy, and flush-integrated appliances complete this refined, clutter-free culinary space.

title: Luxury Bathroom Transformation
shortDescription: A serene master ensuite retreat boasting multi-layer waterproofing, curbless walk-in rainfall shower, and a freestanding soaking tub in Dhanmondi.
description:
This master bathroom transformation in Dhanmondi reimagines the residential ensuite as a restorative private wellness spa. Dwellora stripped the original space down to brickwork, introducing commercial-grade multi-layer waterproofing membranes, updated plumbing lines, and anti-slip large-format porcelain tilework.

The wet zone showcases an expansive curbless walk-in shower with ceiling-flush rainfall heads, concealed stainless linear drainage, and 10mm tempered glass partition. A freestanding solid resin soaking tub rests as a sculptural focal point, complemented by brushed gold tapware. A floating moisture-resistant teak vanity with anti-fog LED illuminated mirrors provides generous organized storage while keeping floor lines completely open and serene.

title: Custom Interior Furniture Project
shortDescription: Handcrafted Chittagong teak and mahogany media feature walls, built-in display joinery, and custom dining furniture in Uttara.
description:
Commissioned for an upscale residence in Uttara, this custom interior furniture project highlights Dwellora’s master joinery and carpentry capabilities across multiple living zones. Every unit was crafted in our workshop using seasoned natural timber, moisture-sealed substrates, and durable eco-friendly PU lacquers.

The centerpiece is a 14-foot architectural TV media wall combining fluted timber slats, acoustic felt backing, floating console storage, and concealed in-wall AV wiring pathways. In the study lounge, floor-to-ceiling built-in bookcases integrate warm LED channel lighting and an executive workstation. In the dining area, a bespoke solid wood dining table with sculpted geometric legs provides an heirloom gathering centerpiece for the family.

title: Premium Wardrobe & Storage Solution
shortDescription: A boutique walk-in dressing suite and custom fitted wardrobe system engineered with fluted bronze glass, valet organizers, and automated lighting.
description:
This premium wardrobe project in Bashundhara Residential Area transformed a dedicated dressing room into a high-end luxury boutique suite. Dwellora engineered wall-to-wall, floor-to-ceiling fitted cabinetry utilizing moisture-resistant core panels finished in subtle textured laminates and solid wood edge bandings.

The wardrobe suite features floor-to-ceiling slim-frame aluminum doors with fluted bronze glass, illuminated angled shoe display tiers, pull-out velvet-lined jewelry drawers, and dual-tier hanging modules for traditional and western attire. Micro-sensor vertical LED channels softly illuminate upon opening. Integrated soft-close sliding tracks and concealed magnetic catches ensure effortless and silent daily operation, bringing order and elegance to personal wardrobes.

title: Elegant Interior Finishing Project
shortDescription: Artisanal wall texturing, Level 5 surface preparation, bespoke ceiling detailing, and premium architectural paint finishing in Mirpur DOHS.
description:
Executed across an expansive contemporary duplex residence in Mirpur DOHS, this interior finishing project represents the pinnacle of surface craftsmanship. Dwellora was engaged to bring depth, tactile warmth, and visual perfection to the walls, ceilings, and architectural moldings.

Our artisans completed comprehensive Level 5 drywall surface preparation followed by multiple hand-applied mineral textures and subtle glaze treatments in warm organic tones. High-profile architectural baseboards, door casing trim, and ceiling coffer reveals were finished with fine spray lacquer applications for brushmark-free perfection. Low-VOC eco-friendly architectural coatings reflect natural light gently, elevating the entire home into a serene, sophisticated living environment.
